label: R27 stormheart
brief: Inside the hollow base of the giant Stormheart tree, two fixed exploration views (top and bottom) in the calm storm phase, timber decks ringing the trunk walls, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the inside of a colossal living storm tree from the key art.
defects: the lightning core reads as a bloomed light pillar, not lightning
the hollow floor reads as a dirt disc in a grass ring, not a living trunk
